summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Brightluxx LED showcase website. All backend APIs working perfectly (100% success rate). Frontend functionality working excellently with minor overlay issue on Compare page.

ui_bugs.issue: Overlay intercepting clicks on compare button - requires force clicks
ui_bugs.workaround: Force clicks work, functionality not broken

GET /api/products returns 24 products list
GET /api/products?category=cob-microled filters by category (3 products)
GET /api/products?trending=true filters trending products (15 products)
GET /api/products?search=COB searches products (6 products)
GET /api/products/categories returns category list
POST /api/products/compare with ['BL-COB060', 'BL-COB093'] returns 2 products
POST /api/calculator/screen-size with venue parameters returns recommendation
POST /api/leads creates lead successfully
GET /api/health returns ok
Home page loads with hero video, navigation, and entry doors
Navbar has Tools dropdown with Calculator, Compare, Tech Guide links
Products page loads with category filter buttons and product cards
Products page search filters products (24 → 6 for 'COB')
Products page category filter works (3 COB MicroLED products)
Product quick view modal opens on card click and closes properly
Calculator page loads with venue parameter sliders
Calculator 'Calculate Recommendation' button returns results with matching products
Compare page loads with product search dropdown and selection
Tech Guide page loads with 4 technology cards (COB, MiP, Transparent, Interactive)
Contact page loads with lead form that submits successfully
Footer has Tools section with Calculator, Compare Products, Technology Guide links
Deep Space Modern design maintained (dark background #0B0B0B, gold accents #E5C574)
